paragraphs: In clinics, address conception, menstruation, and screening and write records and orders. In delivery rooms, monitor labor, deliver babies, and perform cesarean sections. In operating rooms, perform tumor or pelvic-floor surgery. During night shifts, provide emergency rescue at any time. After surgery, discuss recovery during follow-up and organize records and plans.

In short, they protect women's health and newborns at the first critical point. Work includes prenatal care, delivery, surgery, treatment planning, complication management, and follow-up. Combining surgical skill with compassion, they are the final safeguard for maternal and infant safety.
